---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Agent Code Guard defect
---

If this may be a security vulnerability, do not disclose it here. Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/stef-k/agent-code-guard/security/advisories/new) instead.

## Agent Code Guard version or commit

Provide the `code-guard` version if installed or the exact Git commit if running from a checkout.

## Environment

- OS:
- Python version:

## Language / artifact type

For example: Python, TypeScript, Vue, or Markdown.

## Exact command

```text
code-guard . --changed-only
```

## Minimal reproduction

Provide the smallest source, configuration, or input that reproduces the defect. Remove secrets and private or proprietary content.

## Expected result

## Actual result

## Relevant JSON / error output

Include `--json` output, an error message, or a traceback when relevant. Redact secrets and private data.
